hold: The connector-bridge is ready when JARVIS_TOOL_SECRET is set on the Netlify site. GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET / GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN are not required on Netlify — Toquer/Forge fulfills jobs via Grok Bot MCP (user-Google-calendar + user-Gmail). Do not register these tools on the ElevenLabs agent until the fulfill agent is polling bridge-pending. Toquer updates the Jarvis prompt/walls from this file; this repo does not PATCH the agent.

bridge.store: Netlify Blobs (site-scoped, strong consistency, store name jarvis-bridge)

pending.description: List pending jobs for the Toquer/Forge fulfill agent. Max 10, oldest first. Jobs older than ~90s are omitted.

complete.description: Mark a job done and store the speakable result the tool poller is waiting on. Cap lists at 5 items. Times America/Denver.

walls.is: Factual answers from Wade Beatty’s personal calendar, Gmail, and contacts. A ward meeting on the calendar may be reported as a fact only.
is_not: Western Pest business ops (jobs, Cleo, dispatch, quotes, technicians) — redirect to Western / Cleo
Bishop/ward pastoral care, calling assignments, counseling, or ministry workflow — that stays Steward
Send email, create/modify calendar events, or SMS

tools.name: jarvis_calendar
tools.description: Look up Wade Beatty’s personal Google Calendar (America/Denver). Use for schedule, meetings, what’s next, today, tomorrow, or a date range. Read-only.

query.description: Natural language calendar query, e.g. 'tomorrow', 'today', 'this week', or a topic like 'dentist'.

start.description: Optional ISO-8601 start datetime (inclusive). Prefer America/Denver offsets.

end.description: Optional ISO-8601 end datetime (exclusive). Prefer America/Denver offsets.

summary.description: One short spoken line, e.g. '2 events tomorrow.'

examples: I couldn’t check your calendar in time. Try again in a moment.

tools.name: jarvis_email
tools.description: Search Wade Beatty’s Gmail (read-only). Returns from, subject, date, and a short snippet only. Never send mail.

query.description: Natural search such as 'from Sarah', 'unread', or a Gmail query like 'from:name@example.com newer_than:14d'.

q.description: Optional explicit Gmail search string. If set, used as-is.

tools.name: jarvis_contacts
tools.description: Look up someone in Wade Beatty’s contacts. v1: no Grok Bot Contacts MCP — returns a speakable unavailable summary without enqueueing. Keep this webhook path stable.

query.description: Name, email, or phone to look up, e.g. 'Sarah' or '435-555-0100'.

examples: Contacts aren’t on a Grok Bot connector yet — ask about email or calendar instead.

response.summary: Contacts aren’t on a Grok Bot connector yet — ask about email or calendar instead.

prompt_notes_for_toquer: Remove any 'capabilities in v1 are conversational only' / 'no external tools yet' language once tools are actually attached.
Instruct: use jarvis_calendar / jarvis_email when Wade asks about schedule or inbox; say a brief 'let me check' before tool calls.
jarvis_contacts stays registered as a stable path but v1 has no Grok Bot Contacts MCP — the webhook returns a speakable unavailable line. Prefer calendar/email.
Keep Western redirect; keep Steward for pastoral/ministry actions; allow factual calendar/email answers.

Fulfill agent: GET bridge-pending (max 10), run user-Google-calendar / user-Gmail MCP, POST bridge-complete with speakable JSON within ~18s. Do not attach Western/Cleo tool URLs. Draft copy: scripts/jarvis-system-prompt.txt
